conventions.border_rule: light silver on dark blue insignia shows 1/8 in of blue past the widest and tallest point (CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1.1.1, 5.1.1.1.1.3, 5.1.1.1.2.4, 5.1.1.1.2.5, 7.1.1.3.1, 7.1.1.8). Applies to grade insignia, badges and command insignia alike; derived from the item bbox, never stored per item.
exceptions: OCP chest square is a fixed 2 in x 2 in (7.1.1.2.1)
CAP command insignia on OCP sits on a fixed 1 in x 1 in patch (7.1.1.3.1.7)

open_decisions: OCP square: every cadet officer grade uses one common scale (about 0.78 x regular) so the Cadet Colonel / Captain stack just keeps 1/8 in of blue; single-element grades (2d Lt, Major) still leave a lot of blue because the square is a fixed 2 in. Say if you want per-grade fill instead.
Officer bar / leaf proportions are read from Fig A5-2 at an assumed 1 in largest dimension (DAFI 36-2903 7.1.5.1); width and gap are estimates.
Cadet NCO / Airman chevron width (about 1.16 in) is derived from Ethan's statement that the CMSgt chevron fills the 2 in OCP square with ~1/8 in top and bottom; confirm against a real device.
Cloth color #142347 is the 2 x 2 in rank-square and tape blue used by the utility-uniform garments (base-art/make-ocp-abu.js); the regulation only says dark blue (shade 1095 for board braid).
